asr.full_text: Some people notice I don't do things the same way as them I process my senses, in a different way, so any kind of sensory input's very intense for me. One of the things I noticed when I joined JPMorgan Chase is that I was accepted for who I was and for whatever that meant I brought to the table. Once I did get my diagnosis then I was put in touch with the Autism at Work Programme and that's when the support really got put into place. I work in the wholesale client onboarding department. My team mates really appreciate that I have a really good memory for procedures and figures. The Autism at Work programme changed my life and I would love for every autistic person to have the opportunities I have today
